themes.label: Ledger

themes.label: Darkroom
themes.description: A photographer's portfolio on a near-black ground: series of photographs, carousels, grids and a lightbox, services, prints and packages, and a contact form.

themes.name: restaurant
themes.label: Restaurant
themes.description: An all-day restaurant site with a photographed menu, reservations, events, galleries and the people behind the kitchen.

themes.name: nomad
themes.label: Nomad
themes.description: A travel journal for one digital nomad: where you are now, a drawn map of every stop, posts pinned to places and dates, trips, costs, gear and galleries with video loops.

themes.label: Circuit

themes.label: Ritual

themes.name: hospitality
themes.label: Hospitality
themes.description: A small place to stay: cabins, rooms or a hostel as cards with their price and facts, a page for each stay, things to do nearby, reviews, a journal and booking through your booking app.
